text:
alex: Quick note 1: the new Next + LangChain sample in /examples/next-langchain-lite is tripping our eval harness randomly. Short repro in local dev.

juhi: Thanks. Symptoms? 401s, truncated streams, or something else?

alex: Mostly 401 during token rotation, then the SDK retry path replays the request with a stale token and we get partial output. Harness records as truncated.

ben: Which SDK version is the example using?

alex: The example package.json pins @redwood/sdk @ 0.11.9. We shipped 0.12.x fixes for refresh race weeks ago.

juhi: Two follow-ups: 1) bump the example to the latest patch (0.12.3) to get the refresh fix, 2) add an explicit guard that fails fast with a helpful error if the auth header is missing when running in edge.

ben: Agree. Example server handler currently is small:
```js
export const runtime = 'edge';
export default async function handler(req) {
  const { prompt } = await req.json();
  const r = await fetch(`${process.env.REDWOOD_API_URL}/v1/chat`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ prompt })
  });
  return new Response(await r.text(), { status: r.status });
}
```

ben: The edge runtime plus older SDK is the likely race. If process.env isn't present in some edge hosts we might be handing an empty Authorization. Also older SDK did not re-key the refresh flow correctly under concurrent requests.

juhi: For short-term: bump SDK in example, add this guard to top of handler so devs get a clear message:
```js
if (!process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY) throw new Error('REDWOOD_API_KEY missing. Set .env.local or use server runtime for this route.');
```

alex: Good. For long-term, can we add a tiny integration test to the example repo that uses msw to simulate token expiry and asserts the SDK refresh path is exercised and final output is complete? Should be fast.

ben: I'll add a Jest test using msw where the first call returns 401 and the token endpoint returns a refreshed token, then subsequent request succeeds. That would have prevented the eval flake.

juhi: Also tweak our eval harness: treat 401 as potentially transient; retry with exponential backoff up to 3 times and only mark failure if still non-200. This mirrors how real apps behave during rotation.

ci-bot: Created issue #2120: "examples/next-langchain-lite: auth refresh race causes intermittent eval truncation" assigned to ben 12 https://issues.redwood/2120

alex: Thanks. Once PRs land (bump + test + guard) I'll re-run the harness and unflag the job.

devex-bot: PR created: examples/next-langchain-lite#89 - bump sdk @redwood/sdk -> 0.12.3; add env guard; add msw test. CI: pending.

ben: Pinging QA to re-run harness after merge. Small change but high DX impact.

alex: Optional DX note: update README quickstart section to call out 'runtime: edge' gotchas and include the guard snippet. Saves time for new users.

juhi: Love it. Keeping examples rock-solid prevents lots of onboarding ping-pong. :sparkles:
